Short explanation (likely causes):
- Bank account name vs legal entity name mismatch on the W9
- Routing/account numbers flagged by our third-party bank-link provider due to formatting (leading zeros / extra characters)
- File metadata/signature mismatch on the PDF upload (we've seen certain PDF export settings trigger the rejection)

Requested next steps from your side (fastest path):
1) Please re-export the bank statement as a flat PDF (Print -> Save as PDF), and upload via the "Upload Documents" button in the supplier portal (not the drag/drop zone).
2) If possible, also attach a signed W9 (image or PDF).
3) If you prefer, reply with the W9 to this thread and we'll initiate a manual KYC review.

Thanks for the context — I dug into the banklink logs and here's what I see: the provider returned a "routing/account mismatch" error when the routing number submitted didn't match the ACH micro-deposit metadata. That typically happens when the statement PDF is generated by a different sub-entity or when whitespace/formatting alters the parsed numbers.

Options we can take:
1) Manual KYC override: requires a signed W9 + bank statement with the account number visible. This triggers a compliance ticket; manual review is ~24 hours once docs are received.
2) Expedited one-off payment: Finance can approve a manual wire to clear the 9/15 run, but we need CFO approval + an emailed indemnity form from Novus. This avoids waiting for micro-deposits but is an operational exception.
3) Micro-deposit verification: submit the account info and wait 2-3 business days for micro-deposits — not ideal for your deadline.

Given the timeline, if Novus can send the signed W9 right now we can open the manual KYC review and simultaneously route a finance escalation for a one-off wire. Upload instructions above are correct (use Upload Documents). I've created HubSpot ticket HS-45921 and added initial notes: https://hubspot.redwood.com/ticket/HS-45921.

Marissa — if you can confirm Finance is willing to approve the manual wire, I'll start the compliance packet. Ben — please advise on the finance lead for the one-off wire.
